grant_worker_qualification_with_unit: grant a qualification to a worker for specific units and update the worker review record
revoke_worker_qualification_with_unit: revoke a qualification from a worker for specific units and update the worker review record
update_worker_qualification: update a workers qualification value directly and create a new worker review entry with explanation
revoke_worker_qualification: revoke a qualification from a worker directly and create a new worker review entry with explanation
find_units_ids: find all unit IDs associated with a workers granted or revoked qualification from the worker review table
